title: Reduced Vandermonde row index set
statement: For nonnegative integers $k$ and $\ell$, define the reduced Vandermonde binary row index set to consist of one distinguished element together with pairs $(i,r)$ where $0\le i<\lfloor k/2\rfloor$ and $0\le r<\ell$.
